headline: Iraq General Company for Grain Processing consults Bühler on milling upgrades
summary: Iraq's state grain processing subsidiary held talks with Swiss technology firm Bühler to supply spare parts and upgrade technical processing capacity across domestic mills.
why: Iraq is a major Middle Eastern grain importer. Processing infrastructure upgrades directly impact state food supply efficiency.

impacts.name: Iraq
impacts.why: Upgrading milling infrastructure with Swiss technology improves national grain processing capacity.
